title: Queue-overflow drops discard arbitrary fragments and resume mid-GOP; dropped fragments are still acked
test: tests/fmp4RelayPlayer.test.js: 'VAL-107: after an overflow drop, fragments are discarded until one starts on a keyframe', 'VAL-107: interleaved drops never let a mid-GOP fragment in', 'VAL-107: a keyframe fragment that is itself dropped does not end the wait', 'VAL-107: a stall that keeps discarding fragments still ends in a fresh init request', 'VAL-107: the wait for a keyframe holds for the SourceBuffer built after the reset', 'VAL-108: relay-ack is sent for the fragments that were queued, not for dropped ones', 'VAL-108: relay-ack count equals the number of fragments queued through an overflow and a reset', 'VAL-108: an empty fragment is not queued and not acknowledged' (and the guards 'VAL-107: a keyframe ends the wait and the count of consecutive drops starts over', 'VAL-107: with no drop, fragments that do not start on a keyframe are queued as before', 'VAL-107: stop() ends the wait for a keyframe: the same player started again takes any fragment', 'VAL-108: a fragment seen twice is queued and acknowledged once', which pass on the unchanged code or are shown to bite by mutants)
proof: On the unchanged player 8 of the 12 new tests failed for the issue's reasons. With a held SourceBuffer the queue filled to 600; fragment 601 was dropped, one slot freed, and the non-keyframe fragment 602 was queued at once (queueLength expected 599, actual 600), so interleaved drops resumed mid-GOP. relay-ack went out before the overflow check: after 700 fragments with a reset at the 15th drop, 615 acks were sent for 600 queued fragments (expected 600, actual 615); a dropped keyframe fragment was acked (601 acks, expected 600); an empty fragment was acked (expected none). Interleaved drops never reached the 15-drop reset (consecutiveDrops went back to 0 whenever a slot freed), so no fresh init was requested. After the fix: handleMediaChunk sets awaitingKeyframe when the queue is full and then queues nothing until a fragment with keyframeStart === true arrives while the queue has room; fragments discarded while waiting count toward MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DROPS, so a stall still ends in resetAndRequestInit (the 15th consecutive drop, whether queue-full or waiting); the count starts over when a fragment is queued. relay-ack is emitted after enqueue, so the count equals the accepted fragment count (600 of 700 in the overflow test). lastSequence dedupe is unchanged (a fragment seen twice is queued and acked once). The flag survives the overflow reset (the rebuilt SourceBuffer begins on a keyframe) and is cleared by stop(). Mutants: not clearing the flag in stop() fails the restart test; counting only queue-full drops fails the stall test and the after-reset test; acking before the checks fails four VAL-108 tests. lint and typecheck clean, npm test 1148/1148, tests/fmp4RelayPlayer.test.js 48/48 (12 new).
